limitations: Fixtures are synthetic source snapshots, not a read of an enterprise file or database; no application/service was imported or started.
OSV turnover and balance data cannot prove document-level payment allocation, due dates, aging, overdue status, subsidies, or a factual payment DSO.
The parent/leaf fixture follows the daily-row shape used by the tests and source builder; it does not validate every possible parser export layout.
The frontend probe extracts and executes current JavaScript expressions in Node, but it is not a browser/DOM rendering test.
VAT scope is limited to exact 90.03 turnover and does not validate tax rates, invoices, exemptions, or document-level VAT allocation.
Missing-side zero-fill is reported as a finding because the helper cannot distinguish an explicitly booked zero from an absent balance side.

The duplicate-list 62.01 probe is conditional helper contract risk only. Current osvparser daily rows carry turnovers without balance sides, and current DailyRow loader observations have empty analytic paths; the probe does not establish a current end-to-end duplicate incident.
